tagline.zh: 构建==可信==的生成式 AI

intro.en: I am an Assistant Professor at the [College of Artificial Intelligence](https://ai.szu.edu.cn/), Shenzhen University, where I lead [MUSE Lab](lab/) (Multimodal Understanding and Synthesis for Explainability). I received my Ph.D. in Computer Science from [Fudan University](https://www.fudan.edu.cn/) in 2025, advised by Prof. Junping Zhang, and my B.S. in Physics from Fudan University in 2019. I am a member of the Technical Committee on Hybrid Intelligence and the Science Popularization Committee of the Chinese Association of Automation (CAA).
intro.zh: 我是[深圳大学人工智能学院](https://ai.szu.edu.cn/)助理教授、硕士生导师，负责 [MUSE Lab](lab/)（Multimodal Understanding and Synthesis for Explainability Lab）。2025 年博士毕业于[复旦大学](https://www.fudan.edu.cn/)计算机科学技术专业，师从张军平教授；2019 年本科毕业于复旦大学物理学专业。现为中国自动化学会混合智能专委会、普及工作专委会会员。

intro.en: My research aims to make generative AI **controllable, interpretable, and trustworthy**. I study why text-to-image diffusion models succeed or fail on specific concepts and how to edit images and videos precisely and consistently; how large language models and agents stay reliable — free of hallucination, bias, and state collapse — over long-horizon interaction; and how generative agents can perceive and express human emotion. I am also interested in bringing these models to real-world applications such as emotional companionship, virtual try-on, and digital humans.
intro.zh: 我的研究目标是让生成式 AI 更加**可控、可解释、可信**：研究文生图扩散模型为何在特定概念上成功或失败，以及如何实现精确、一致的图像与视频编辑；研究大语言模型与智能体如何在长程交互中保持可靠，避免幻觉、偏见与状态崩塌；研究生成式智能体如何感知并表达人类情感。同时探索这些技术在情感陪伴、虚拟试衣、数字人等真实场景中的落地应用。

lab.name: MUSE Lab
lab.full: Multimodal Understanding and Synthesis for Explainability
lab.en: My group works on AIGC, multimodal understanding and generation, large language models, retrieval-augmented generation, persona-based language modeling, and emotional agents.
lab.zh: 实验室聚焦 AIGC、多模态理解与生成、大语言模型、检索增强生成（RAG）、人格化语言建模与情感智能体等方向。

title.zh: 可控、可解释的视觉生成与编辑

text.en: Why do diffusion models fail on specific concepts, and how can we edit images and videos precisely while keeping semantics consistent and identities intact?
text.zh: 扩散模型为何会在特定概念上失效？如何在保持语义一致与身份不变的前提下，实现精确的图像与视频编辑？

title.zh: 可信的大模型与智能体

text.en: Keeping LLMs and agents reliable: constraint and state integrity in long-horizon dialogue and agent handoffs, reflective search for code generation, and AI-for-AI systems that write academic surveys.
text.zh: 让大模型与智能体更可靠：长程对话与多智能体交接中的约束与状态保持、面向代码生成的反思式搜索，以及自动撰写学术综述的 AI for AI 系统。

text.en: From facial expression and micro-expression analysis to emotional agents that understand and respond to people, extending toward embodied AI and world models.
text.zh: 从人脸表情与微表情分析，到能够理解并回应人的情感智能体，并进一步拓展到具身智能与世界模型。

applications.en: **Applications:** emotional companionship, virtual try-on, end-to-end apparel automation, and digital humans.
applications.zh: **应用场景：**情感陪伴、虚拟试衣、服装全流程自动化、数字人建模。
